name: Bookkeeping Firm Operations
audience: small bookkeeping firms and client accounting service teams
topic: client inputs and recurring close workflows for bookkeeping firms

products.name: Client Document Chaser
products.product: A recurring request tracker for statements, receipts, payroll records, and explanations needed to complete bookkeeping work.
products.audience: small bookkeeping firms and client accounting service teams
products.problem: Client requests are repeated across email threads without a clear item-level status, acceptance check, or effect on the close schedule.
products.valueProposition: Makes every requested input specific, secure, owned, validated, and connected to the blocked bookkeeping task.
products.topic: bookkeeping client document collection and reminder tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets bookkeeping document request list, client reminder email, month-end document checklist, and accounting client portal searches.

products.name: Portfolio Close Monitor
products.product: A cross-client month-end close view that highlights task ownership, evidence, blockers, review queues, and delivery risk.
products.audience: small bookkeeping firms and client accounting service teams
products.problem: Firm owners cannot see which client closes are truly at risk without opening multiple checklists, inboxes, and accounting files.
products.valueProposition: Standardizes close stages and exceptions across clients while keeping accounting work in the underlying ledger systems.
products.topic: bookkeeping month-end close checklist and portfolio tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets bookkeeping month-end checklist, accounting close tracker, client close dashboard, and recurring workflow software searches.
